text: Hebr. let him weigh mee in balances of Iustice.
Or, did hee not fashion vs in one wombe?
Hebr. my hand hath kissed my mouth.
Or, after the manner of men.
Or, behold my signe is that the Almightie will answere mee.
Heb. the strength thereof. , Heb. caused the soule of the owners therof to expire, or breath out.
